evidence.validity_definition: A reuse candidate is usable iff (1) it is a regular file; (2) its bytes parse as ONE JSON object; (3) 'nodes' is a non-empty array; (4) 'links' is present and an array (empty allowed). 'communities' is NOT required: the authoritative repo graph has no top-level communities key and graph_stats/from_store tolerate its absence. Everything downstream (graph_stats, read_graph, miner graph context, lanes community attachment) consumes exactly nodes/links, so a zero-node graph is unusable however well-formed. Not detectable: a graph that parses with non-zero nodes but is semantically wrong (stale, wrong repo, truncated yet valid JSON).
